title: [HIGH SEVERITY VULNERABILITY] `instantsearch.js` should use `qs@^6.14.1` instead of `^6.5.1 < 6.10`
body:
### 🐛 Current behavior

Currently, in `packages/instantsearch.js/package.json`, there is:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "qs": "^6.5.1 < 6.10"
  }
}
```

But with `qs <6.14.1`, there's a high severity vulnerability:
[qs's arrayLimit bypass in its bracket notation allows DoS via memory exhaustion](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6rw7-vpxm-498p)

This vulnerability was fixed in patched version `6.14.1`.

I hope there's no reason to have `< 6.10`.

### 🔍 Steps to reproduce

When installing:

* `react-instantsearch@latest` *(currently `7.22.0`)*
* or `instantsearch.js@latest` *(currently `4.86.0`)*

`npm i` or `npm audit` will display the high severity vulnerabilities in the console.

### Live reproduction

https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/github/algolia/instantsearch/tree/templates/react-instantsearch

### 💭 Expected behavior

* No `high severity vulnerabilities` should appear in the console when installing `react-instantsearch@latest`
* In instantsearch.js `package.json`, there should be: `"qs": "^6.14.1"`

### Package version

`instantsearch.js@4.86.0` *(via `react-instantsearch@7.22.0`)*
